correctness.rationale: The standard derivative is a bijection and turns one length-\(\ell\) tandem duplication into insertion of \(\ell\) zeros. For a fixed nonzero skeleton, two distinct sources conflict exactly when their zero-run vectors differ by \(\ell(e_i-e_j)\); the signed support uniquely identifies \(i,j\), so there is exactly one common output. Counting legal donor states by weak compositions and summing over skeletons yields the stated closed formula. The standalone verifier independently reconstructs both the channel and derivative relation over a bounded multi-parameter grid.
